Name: Sunflower Farm - New Farm
Author: violetskye5
Description:
[b]Description:[/b]
A new farm type with more buildings, machines, and animals. This is the normal start version.


[b]Installation Instructions:[/b]
Download the mod via a mod manager for automatic installation or download manually, ensure the compressed file is placed within the Stardew Valley\mods folder, extract all from the compressed file in the same location. Both files must be downloaded and installed for it to work.  You need to start a new farm after downloading for the farm to work, it will not add buildings in the right place if you add it to another save.


[b]Main Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]1 coop with a ducks, chicken, and a rabbit[/*]
[*]1 barn with a sheep, cow, and goat[/*]
[*]5 re-growable stumps[/*]
[*]1 chests with items in barn[/*]
[*]mountain fish are catchable on farm[/*]
[/list]
[b]Differences:[/b]
[list]
[*]less extra starting seeds[/*]
[*]less extra things in chest[/*]
[*]paths and farming areas are not cleared of fiber, stone, and wood[/*]
[/list]
[b]Other Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]replaces the standard farm[/*]
[*]there are no starter cabins locations[/*]
[*]made with help from LeeloMods[/*]
[*]you can download just the content pack for just the map without the buildings, animals, or extra chest[/*]
[/list][b]Compatibility:[/b]
[list]
[*]works with DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor - go into the sunflowerfarmcontentpack, open assets folder, delete all tilesheets (leave "Farm_Decorate" (that is the only thing you need with the recolor)[/*]
[/list]
